audience: repair shop teams managing tickets, customers, parts and invoices in RepairDesk

useCases.title: Get up to speed on a repair
useCases.text: Find a ticket by keyword, then review its customer, device, status, notes and line items before responding to a customer.

useCases.title: Review upcoming appointments
useCases.text: Read appointments with customer, device and assignment details to prepare for the next repair intake.

useCases.title: Check parts and stock
useCases.text: Look up an item by name or SKU, review available stock and inspect its condition and storage location options.

useCases.title: Answer an invoice balance question
useCases.text: Find an invoice, review its details and check the outstanding amount and paid flag before discussing payment with a customer.

useCases.title: Record a confirmed internal note
useCases.text: Review the selected ticket and note text, then append an internal note after explicit confirmation. Inspect the ticket notes before retrying an uncertain result.
